'''Mindaugas Kuzminskas''' (born 19 October 1989) is a Lithuanian professional [[basketball]] player. He also formerly represented the [[Lithuania men's national basketball team|Lithuanian national team]] in international competition. He is 2.05 m (6'8 {{3/4}}") tall, and he can play at both the [[small forward]] and [[power forward]] positions.

==Professional career==
[[File:Mindaugas Kuzminskas by Augustas Didzgalvis.jpg|150px|thumb|left|Kuzminskas with [[Lithuania men's national basketball team|Lithuanian national team]].]]

===Europe===
Kuzminskas started his basketball career in 2006 with [[BC Sakalai|Sakalai]] where he played for one season. For the 2007–08 season, he moved to [[BC Perlas|Perlas]]. In the summer of 2008, he signed with [[BC Šiauliai|Šiauliai]].{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}

In September 2009, Kuzminskas signed with [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris]], but he stayed one more season on loan with Šiauliai.<ref>{{cite news|title=Zalgiris inks Kuzminskas|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/cups/euroleague/78857/zalgiris-inks-kuzminskas.html|access-date=22 November 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=11 September 2009}}</ref> In 2010, he joined Žalgiris and stayed with the team for three seasons.{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}

In June 2013, Kuzminskas signed a contract with the Spanish team [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Unicaja announce Mindaugas Kuzminskas|url=http://basketball.eurobasket.com/Euroleague/news/321735|access-date=22 November 2014|work=Eurobasket.com|date=28 June 2013}}</ref> On 22 October 2015, Kuzminskas scored his [[EuroLeague]] career-high 23 points and led his team to triumph versus the [[Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]] 93–82 in [[Tel Aviv]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Rekordinio Mindaugo Kuzminsko vakaro atgarsiai: "Nesustabdomas. Užkariautojas. Žvaigždė"|url=http://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/europa/rekordinio-mindaugo-kuzminsko-vakaro-atgarsiai-nesustabdomas-uzkariautojas-zvaigzde-874-536030|language=lt|website=24sek.lt|access-date=23 October 2015}}</ref> Then on 13 November, Kuzminskas played his most efficient EuroLeague game of 30 [[Performance Index Rating|PIR points]] (22 points (2FG: 6/7, 3FG: 3/5, FT: 1/1), 4 rebounds, 3 steals) and led Unicaja to another outstanding away-game victory, this time against [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]], winning 86–78.<ref>{{cite web|title=CSKA Moscow vs. Unicaja Malaga - Game|url=http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=58&seasoncode=E2015|website=Euroleague.net|access-date=13 November 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Mindaugas Kuzminskas sužaidė geriausias karjeros Eurolygoje rungtynes|url=http://www.basketnews.lt/news-91059-mindaugas-kuzminskas-suzaide-geriausias-karjeros-eurolygoje-rungtynes.html|language=lt|website=BasketNews.lt|access-date=13 November 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Ispanija ekstazėje – su Kuzminsku nors ir į pasaulio kraštą|url=http://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/europa/ispanija-ekstazeje-su-kuzminsku-nors-ir-i-pasaulio-krasta-874-541763|language=lt|website=24sek.lt|access-date=14 November 2015}}</ref> In 36 [[Liga ACB|league]] games for Unicaja in 2015–16, he averaged 10.3 points, 3.0 rebounds and 1.1 assists per game.{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}

===NBA===
On 9 July 2016, Kuzminskas signed with the [[New York Knicks]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign Mindaugas Kuzminskas|url=http://www.nba.com/knicks/knicks-sign-mindaugas-kuzminskas|publisher=NBA|date=9 July 2016|access-date=9 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=M. Kuzminskas – jau oficialiai NBA žaidėjas: tapau "Knicks" šeimos nariu!|url=http://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/m-kuzminskas-jau-oficialiai-nba-zaidejas-tapau-knicks-seimos-nariu.d?id=71755918|language=lt|publisher=Delfi|date=9 July 2016|access-date=9 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Mindaugas Kuzminskas: apie atradimus Niujorke, Porzingio pagalbą ir muzikinius sugebėjimus|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-102333-mindaugas-kuzminskas-apie-atradimus-niujorke-porzingio-pagalba-ir-muzikinius-sugebejimus.html|website=BasketNews.lt|access-date=20 October 2016}}</ref> On 25 October, he made his debut for the Knicks in their season opener, scoring seven points in nine minutes off the bench in a 117–88 loss to the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore?gameId=400899375|title=Knicks vs. Cavaliers – Box Score|work=ESPN.com|date=25 October 2016|access-date=25 October 2016}}</ref> On 3 January 2017, Kuzminskas was selected as the 2016 [[Lithuanian Basketball Player of the Year]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Geriausi 2016-ųjų Lietuvos krepšininkai – M. Kuzminskas ir K. Nacickaitė |url=https://www.lrt.lt/naujienos/sportas/9/159216/geriausi_2016-uju_lietuvos_krepsininkai_m._kuzminskas_ir_k._nacickaite |website=Lithuanian National Radio and Television |access-date=17 August 2025 |language=lt |date=3 January 2017}}</ref> On 12 January 2017, he scored a season-high 19 points in a 104–89 win over the [[Chicago Bulls]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400900008|title=Knicks beat Bulls with big games from Anthony, Rose, Noah|work=ESPN.com|date=12 January 2017|access-date=13 January 2017}}</ref>

On 12 November 2017, Kuzminskas was waived by the Knicks to make room for the return of the suspended [[Joakim Noah]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/21389289/new-york-knicks-waive-mindaugas-kuzminskas-make-room-joakim-noah|title=With Joakim Noah returning from suspension, Knicks waive Mindaugas Kuzminskas|work=ESPN.com|date=12 November 2017|access-date=12 November 2017}}</ref> He appeared in 68 games during his rookie season, but just one game to begin his second season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/article/2017/11/12/new-york-knicks-waive-mindaugas-kuzminskas#/|title=New York Knicks waive forward Mindaugas Kuzminskas|work=NBA.com|date=12 November 2017|access-date=12 November 2017}}</ref>

===Return to Europe===
On 1 January 2018, Kuzminskas signed with the Italian club [[Pallacanestro Olimpia Milano|Olimpia Milano]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Mindaugas Kuzminskas is coming to Milan|url=http://www.olimpiamilano.com/en/mindaugas-kuzminskas-is-coming-to-milan/|access-date=1 January 2018|work=Olimpiamilano.com|date=1 January 2018}}</ref> On 1 July 2019, Kuzminskas parted ways with Olimpia Milano after a season and a half playing for them and winning one Italian championship.{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}

On 22 July 2019, Kuzminskas signed a two-year contract with Greek club [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Γραβιά |first1=Τζένη |title="'Έπιασε" Λιμάνι ο Κουζμίνσκας! |url=https://www.olympiacosbc.gr/el/news-el/latest-news-el/5617-%C2%AB%CE%AD%CF%80%CE%B9%CE%B1%CF%83%CE%B5%C2%BB-%CE%BB%CE%B9%CE%BC%CE%AC%CE%BD%CE%B9-%CE%BF-%CE%BA%CE%BF%CF%85%CE%B6%CE%BC%CE%AF%CE%BD%CF%83%CE%BA%CE%B1%CF%82.html |website=Olympiacos BC |access-date=23 July 2019 |language=el-GR |date=22 July 2019}}</ref> On 9 November 2019, with playing time declining since October, Kuzminskas was released from the Greek club.

On 11 November 2019, Kuzminskas signed a [[Euro|€]]1.5 million deal with [[PBC Lokomotiv Kuban|Lokomotiv Kuban]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Mindaugas Kuzminskas joined Loko! |url=https://lokobasket.com/en/news/87147/ |website=lokobasket.com |access-date=6 March 2020 |date=11 November 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Oficialu: 1,5 mln. eurų uždirbsiantis M.Kuzminskas padėjo parašą po sutartimi su "Lokomotiv-Kuban" ekipa |url=https://www.krepsinis.net/naujiena/oficialu-1-5-mln-euru-uzdirbsiantis-m-kuzminskas-padejo-parasa-po-sutartimi-su-lokomotiv-kuban-ekipa/299664 |website=krepsinis.net |access-date=17 February 2020 |language=lt}}</ref> Kuzminskas was selected to the [[VTB United League All-Star Game|2020 VTB United League All-Star Game]] where he scored 14 points, grabbed 1 rebound and dished out 4 assists.<ref>{{cite web |title="Pasaulio" rinktinei atstovavę A.Juškevičius ir M.Kuzminskas žibėjo Rusijos žvaigždžių mače |url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/nba/pasaulio-rinktinei-atstovave-a-juskevicius-ir-m-kuzminskas-zibejo-rusijos-zvaigzdziu-mace-1130-1277148 |website=[[15min.lt]] |access-date=17 February 2020 |language=lt}}</ref> During the 2020–21 season, Kuzminskas averaged 13 points και 4.5 rebounds in 40 games in the [[VTB United League]] and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}

On 5 July 2021 he signed with the Russian team [[BC Zenit Saint Petersburg|Zenit Saint Petersburg]] of the [[VTB United League]] and the [[EuroLeague]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://basket.fc-zenit.ru/news/feed/2021/07/05/mindaugas-kuzminskas-novyy-igrok-bk-zenit-/|title=Миндаугас Кузминскас – новый игрок БК "Зенит"!|last=|first=|date=July 5, 2021|website=fc-zenit.ru|publisher=|language=ru|access-date=July 5, 2021}}</ref> He left the team after the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/591726/guerre-en-ukraine-ces-joueurs-etrangers-qui-nont-pas-quitte-les-equipes-russes-engagees-en-euroleague/|title=Guerre en Ukraine: ces joueurs étrangers qui n'ont pas quitté les équipes russes engagées en Euroleague | Basket Europe|date=March 11, 2022}}</ref>

On 21 September 2022 he signed with [[Karşıyaka Basket|Pınar Karşıyaka]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba-champions-league/1394040/mindaugas-kuzminskas-officially-joins-pinar-karsiyaka/|title=Mindaugas Kuzminskas officially joins Pinar Karsiyaka|last=|first=|date=September 21, 2022|website=|publisher=Eurohoops|language=En|access-date=September 22, 2022}}</ref>

On July 22, Kuzminskas joined [[AEK B.C.|AEK Athens]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Sportando |first=Redazione |date=2023-07-22 |title=AEK expected to sign Mindaugas Kuzminskas - Sportando |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/aek-expected-to-sign-mindaugas-kuzminskas/ |access-date=2024-07-15 |work=Sportando |language=en-US}}</ref> In the end of the season, he renewed his contract with the club until 2026.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Maggi |first=Alessandro |date=2024-07-15 |title=Mindaugas Kuzminskas re-signs with Aek until 2026 - Sportando |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/mindaugas-kuzminskas-re-signs-with-aek-until-2026/ |access-date=2024-07-15 |work=Sportando |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Both of Kuzminskas' parents were professional athletes, his father, Vladas, played [[table tennis]], while his mother, Zita, was a professional basketball player.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Vorkunov|first1=Mike|title=Why Not EuroKnicks? For Struggling Team, Hope From Abroad|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/30/sports/basketball/knicks-europe-mindaugas-kuzminskas-kristaps-porzingis.html|website=The New York Times|access-date=18 May 2017|date=30 January 2017}}</ref> He also has an older brother, Saulius, who was also a professional basketball player between 1999 and 2015.<ref>{{cite web|title=S.Kuzminskas pranešė apie karjeros pabaigą|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-85134-skuzminskas-pranese-apie-karjeros-pabaiga.html|language=lt|access-date=6 May 2015}}</ref> When Kuzminskas was 13 he visited [[Canada]]. During his trip to Canada, he toured the [[Toronto Raptors]]' arena<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/BPS9H8eBrxH/ |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/iarchive/s/instagram/BPS9H8eBrxH |archive-date=2021-12-24 |url-access=limited|title=Instagram post by Mindaugas Kuzminskas • Jan 15, 2017 at 7:07pm UTC|website=Instagram|language=en|access-date=2017-09-27}}{{cbignore}}</ref> and went to Kretinga, a Lithuanian Youth Summer Camp in [[Wasaga Beach|Wasaga Beach, Ontario]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/CampKretinga/posts/1145450262144999|title=Lithuanian Youth Camp Kretinga / Kretingos Stovykla|website=www.facebook.com|language=en|access-date=2017-09-27}}</ref> In 2017, after 6 years of dating, he married Lithuanian ballet dancer Eglė Andreikaitė. The couple announced their separation in 2019.<ref>{{cite web|title=M. Kuzminskas patvirtino gandus apie skyrybas su žmona: aš norėjau šeimos ir vaikų|date=22 October 2018 |url=https://www.diena.lt/naujienos/laisvalaikis-ir-kultura/zvaigzdes-ir-pramogos/m-kuzminskas-patvirtino-gandus-apie-skyrybas-su-zmona-norejau-seimos-ir-vaiku-885996|language=lt|access-date=17 September 2019}}</ref>

===Don't Snooze On Kuz===
While in the NBA, a fan-made Instagram account entitled "[https://www.instagram.com/dontsnoozeonkuz/ dontsnoozeonkuz]" gained popularity through various satirical and serious postings about Kuzminskas. The account mainly focused on promoting Kuzminskas as a basketball player, and frequently requested his then-current team, the [[New York Knicks]], to increase his playing time. Kuzminskas followed "dontsnoozeonkuz," which has amassed over 1,200 followers as of 29 June 2017. "Dontsnoozeonkuz" is still active today despite the end of Kuzminskas' NBA tenure.
